# AnnoyingKids.com
> https://annoyingkids.com

Bold, loud merch for kids aged 6-16 who live life at maximum volume.

## What We Do
AnnoyingKids is a print-on-demand e-commerce brand selling graphic tees, hoodies, mugs, stickers, and caps designed for kids who refuse to blend in. Every item is printed when ordered — no warehouses, no waste, shipped directly to your door. We combine neon-cyberpunk aesthetics with humor that kids love and parents tolerate.

## Key Differentiators
- Print-on-demand: zero inventory waste, each item made fresh per order
- Unique neon/glitch art designs not found anywhere else
- Family-friendly humor that appeals to kids AND parents
- Original character universe (Guy, Buddy, Papuu, Mal, Mimi, Barry) with lore and a playable browser game
- Secure checkout via Stripe; ships to US and internationally
- 30-day no-questions-asked returns

## Pricing Overview
- Graphic Tees: $15 - $32
- Hoodies: $26 - $43
- Mugs (11oz/15oz): $14 - $19
- Kiss-Cut Stickers: $2.41 - $6
- Embroidered Caps: $40

## Target Audiences
- Kids aged 6-16 who want expressive, bold clothing
- Parents buying fun, unique gifts for energetic kids
- Birthday party and holiday gift shoppers
- Fans of anime, glitch art, and neon streetwear aesthetics
